Mechanism: URLHelper::join(base, resolveEndpoint()/defineEndpoint()) returned a syntactically valid absolute endpoint unchanged, discarding the connector base; the resulting URI was then sent with connector/request auth headers. At BIC bef86d8bdec2deec452695cac9517b9ec0b63d7c, SaloonRequest::getFullRequestUrl() called URLHelper::join($this->getConnector()->defineBaseUrl(), $this->defineEndpoint()); ManagesGuzzle::createGuzzleRequest() built GuzzleHttp\Psr7\Request with getFullRequestUrl(); RequestManager::hydrate() ran authenticateRequest() (authenticator from request or connector) then mergeHeaders(connector, request) and send() attached RequestOptions::HEADERS. At v3.15.0 (8039c76132ca52d08c887407773a770c15ab04a0) PendingRequest::__construct still assigns $this->url = URLHelper::join(resolveBaseUrl(), resolveEndpoint()) then taps MergeRequestProperties and AuthenticatePendingRequest. User-controlled resolveEndpoint therefore yields SSRF/credential leakage as described.
